name: Unearthed Grounds
summary: The Unearthed Grounds is an excavation site nestled north of Greatwood Vale in the Stonetalon Mountains. Originally established by the dwarven Explorers' League to unearth ancient fossils and relics, the dig has since been overrun and seized by the Horde.

sections.title: A Contested Digsite
sections.body: Tucked away in the rugged heights of the Stonetalon Mountains, the Unearthed Grounds began as a promising survey site for the dwarven Explorers' League. Intrigued by the primeval history preserved in Kalimdor's rock layers, dwarven prospectors began excavating the hillside for ancient fossils. However, operating so close to expanding Horde operations made the camp an immediate target. Horde forces attacked the dig, violently driving out the researchers and seizing control of the overturned earth, leaving behind a scarred, contested hillside in the wilderness.

faq.answer: It is an excavation site in the Stonetalon Mountains, located just north of Greatwood Vale and east of the Northwatch Expedition Base Camp. It was carved out to uncover ancient fossils and artifacts buried in the slopes.

faq.q: Who dug up this site originally?
faq.answer: The site was founded by prospectors and scholars belonging to Ironforge's Explorers' League, who ventured across the sea to uncover Kalimdor's prehistoric secrets.

faq.q: Why is the Horde here now?
aliases: why did horde attack unearthed grounds
faq.answer: The Horde drove out the dwarven researchers to check Alliance expansion within the Stonetalon Mountains and secure tactical ground near Greatwood Vale.

faq.q: What are they looking for here?
aliases: what kind of dig is unearthed grounds
faq.answer: The dig primarily targets ancient fossils embedded in the mountain strata, as the Explorers' League sought to catalog Kalimdor's primordial natural history.

angles.text: The loss of the digsite to the Horde strikes a painful blow to the Explorers' League's efforts to study the ancient, untapped history of Kalimdor.
Seizing the excavation stopped Alliance operatives from establishing a lasting logistical foothold right above Greatwood Vale.
